recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed for FHIR-27083 unless a future work group decision changes the List/Group boundary or asks for a new conformance rule beyond the already-applied guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-27083 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core FHIR-I request asking whether List and Group should be merged because patient-list implementers found overlap. The final decision did not merge the resources; it directed adding guidance to group.html#bnr that Group should be preferred when suitable, such as collections of patients that may be subjects of measures, observations, communications, or similar actions.
initial_application: The guidance was previously applied in source history. Commit 50a8a1a8be added the approved text to source/group/group-introduction.xml on 2022-08-10, merge commit a78d8bbb76 brought the apply-FHIR-27083 branch into R5 ballot staging history, and commit c47ed18f2c reapplied the same guidance with minor line wrapping on 2022-08-30. Current blame still traces the substantive guidance lines to c47ed18f2c, with later punctuation-only cleanup on one line.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Group and List as active resources and approved artifacts, so the inspected Group/List source is in current build scope. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-06-01 confirm the Group-as-actor versus List-as-view rationale and the 11-0-0 Persuasive with Mod vote. Zulip discussions before and after the vote quote the same guidance and do not show a later reversal. FHIR-27903 is a related List/Group clarification that is already represented on the combined branch and supports keeping separate boundary guidance rather than adding redundant text here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/group/group-introduction.xml:49-62 already contains the requested Group preference guidance in an active resource page.
